O'Connell Center]] |champion= |conf_champ = |conf_champ_result = |bowl= [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2017–18 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Florida Gators men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Florida]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Gators were led by third year head coach [[Mike White (basketball)|Mike White]] and played their home games in the [[O'Connell Center|Exactech Arena at the Stephen C. O'Connell Center]] on the university's [[Gainesville, Florida]], campus as members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 21–13, 11–7 in SEC play to finish in third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]], 80–72. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]], 77–62, in the First Round before losing to [[2017–18 Texas Tech Red Raiders men's basketball team|Texas Tech]], 69–66, in the Second Round. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Gators]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 27–9, 14–4 in SEC play to finish in second place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2017 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] in overtime to 7-seed [[2016–17 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.seccountry.com/vanderbilt/vanderbilt-florida-sec-semifinals-tournament|title=Vanderbilt wins overtime thriller, beating Florida for the third time to advance to SEC semifinals|date=2017-03-10|work=SEC Country|access-date=2017-09-29|language=en-US}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.miamiherald.com/sports/college/sec/university-of-florida/article137871513.html|title=Vanderbilt upsets Florida Gators in SEC tournament quarterfinals|work=miamiherald|access-date=2017-09-29|language=en}} They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the East Region's No. 4 seed. They defeated 13-seed [[2016–17 East Tennessee State Buccaneers basketball team|East Tennessee State]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400946418|title=East Tennessee State vs. Florida – Game Recap – March 16, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-09-29}} and 5-seed [[2016–17 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen.{{Cite news|url=http://www.oregonlive.com/march-madness/index.ssf/2017/03/florida_vs_virginia_live_score.html|title=Florida routs Virginia to advance to Sweet 16: NCAA Tournament second round|work=OregonLive.com|access-date=2017-09-29|language=en-US}} In the Sweet Sixteen, they defeated 8-seed [[2016–17 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] with a three-pointer at the buzzer in overtime to earn a trip to the Elite Eight.{{Cite news|url=https://www.sbnation.com/college-basketball/2017/3/25/15058312/florida-wisconsin-sweet-16-game-winner-chris-chiozza-ncaa-tournament-2017|title=Florida and Wisconsin gave us March Madness perfection in final minutes of the Sweet 16|work=SBNation.com|access-date=2017-09-29}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400947266|title=Wisconsin vs. Florida – Game Recap – March 24, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-09-29}} In the Elite Eight, they lost to fellow SEC member 7-seed [[2016–17 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.oregonlive.com/march-madness/index.ssf/2017/03/florida_vs_south_carolina_live.html|title=South Carolina headed to Final Four after topping Florida: NCAA Tournament live updates recap, highlights, score, stats|work=OregonLive.com|access-date=2017-09-29|language=en-US}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
